description: Ministry of Power and Energy - The Petroleum Resources (Joint Study Agreements) Regulations No.03 of 2024.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Power and Energy under the Petroleum Resources Act, No. 21 of 2021. It establishes the legal framework and regulatory procedures for joint study agreements related to petroleum resources exploration. The content focuses entirely on creating new regulatory requirements, procedures, and compliance mechanisms rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
